// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-COMPUTED-SELECTION
// Assembled at runtime, so no amount of literal matching can decode it. This is
// why an unreadable key is refused rather than analysed: the gate cannot know
// what this selects, and neither can a reviewer.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

const FIELD = ["family", "Code"].join("");

export async function parentByEmail(email) {
  return db.parent.findUnique({ where: { email }, select: { id: true, [FIELD]: true } });
}
